verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Sketch acting as an MCP *server* that external AI clients (e.g. Claude, Cursor) can connect to and use Sketch's own tools (sketch-docs-18, sketch-docs-34) — the reverse of the story, which asks whether Sketch itself can plug in external MCP servers to consume their tools. No documentation or community evidence indicates Sketch can act as an MCP client consuming third-party tool servers.
